summary.text: Kayden Bennett is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 81 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Blake Carpenter.
A U.S. Army veteran, foster parent and farmer, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he wants government to be more transparent and accessible.

paragraphs.text: Kayden Bennett served in the U.S. Army, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Philadelphia, served as a combat military police officer and suffered a severe traumatic brain injury in service.
He said he later moved to Kansas to be closer to family and is building Swift Rain Farmstead with his wife.

Bennett said in the survey that his policy interests include public safety and accountability, health care access, foster care reform, senior care, housing affordability, education funding and government transparency.
